brief.head: Chase cards slip this week while sealed holds steady
brief.body: The Chase 100 is down 4.7% this week at $31,944, and Modern Sealed 100 is down 0.2%. Biggest jump today: Realm of Death (Radiance), up 147% to $12.78. 197 cards worth $10+ show steady week-long gains, 510 are cooling off. Best grading pick: Magikarp - 203/193 (SV02: Paldea Evolved), PSA 10 sells for 11.6x raw.
